title: John the Baptist Preaches
description: John the Baptist appears in the wilderness of Judea, preaching repentance because the kingdom of heaven is near. He baptizes people in the Jordan River, warns the Pharisees and Sadducees against false security in their descent from Abraham, and points to a stronger one who will come after him and baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire. [ref:Matt 3:1-12|Matthew 3:1-12]
